title: 2 Secrets Hidden Inside the Ferrari F40
description:
The Ferrari F forty was built in thirteen months, from the leftovers of a racing programme that had been cancelled. And it had no door handles, no glove box, no leather and no sound system. Yet it cost about four hundred thousand dollars, roughly five times the car it replaced, and speculators sold some for more than seven times list price. These are the two secrets hidden inside the Ferrari F forty. Here is the twist. Ferrari planned to build four hundred of them. It built more than thirteen hundred. And the same page that tells us all that also says only about ten percent of the cars delivered were used for regular driving. Stay to the end, because the sources disagree on several numbers, and we will show you where.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
